# Components

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-components-doc.mjs from calcit.cirru; edit the definitions' :doc and :examples instead. -->

Import components from `respo-ui.comp` and their option structs from `respo-ui.schema`.

```cirru
ns app.comp.demo $ :require
  respo.core :refer $ defcomp div <>
  respo-ui.comp :refer $ comp-button comp-field comp-input
  respo-ui.schema :refer $ ButtonOptions FieldOptions InputOptions
```

Every component returns `respo.schema/Component`. Most take an `Option` of a
named options struct as the last argument: pass `Option :none` for defaults,
or `Option :some` with the struct constructor. `comp-tabs` and
`comp-attributes` take the struct itself, and `comp-time` and
`comp-placeholder` take no options; the headings below show each signature.
The constructor fills every omitted `Option` field with `Option :none`, so
only write the fields you use:

```cirru
comp-button "|Save" $ Option :some $ ButtonOptions :kind (Option :some :primary)
```

Callbacks such as `:on-change` receive the new value and `d!`; call `d!` with
your app's operation tuple, for example `d! $ :: :set-language value`.
Run `calcit query def respo-ui.comp/<name>` for the full schema of any component.

## Form controls

### `comp-button (content options)`

Render a native button with Respo UI variants. Options: :kind (:primary, :danger, :danger-outline), :type, :disabled, :on-click, :class-name, :style.

```cirru
comp-button |Save $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/ButtonOptions :kind $ Option :some :primary
```

### `comp-input (value options)`

Render a controlled text input. Pass the current value and optional :type, :placeholder, :disabled, :on-input, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-input |query $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/InputOptions :placeholder $ Option :some |Search
```

### `comp-textarea (value options)`

Render a controlled textarea. Pass the current value and optional :placeholder, :disabled, :on-input, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-textarea |notes $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/InputOptions :placeholder $ Option :some |Notes
```

### `comp-select (value items options)`

Render a controlled native select from SelectOption items, each with :value, :label, and optional :disabled. Options: :disabled, :on-change (receives the next value and d!), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-select |calcit
  [] $ respo-ui.schema/SelectOption :value |calcit :label |Calcit
  Option :some $ respo-ui.schema/SelectOptions
```

### `comp-checkbox (checked options)`

Render a controlled native checkbox. Shares SwitchOptions with comp-switch: :label, :disabled, :on-change (receives the next Bool and d!), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-checkbox true $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/SwitchOptions :label $ Option :some "|Remember me"
```

### `comp-switch (checked options)`

Render a controlled accessible switch backed by a native checkbox. Options: :label, :disabled, :on-change, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-switch false $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/SwitchOptions :label $ Option :some "|Compact mode"
```

### `comp-radio-group (value items options)`

Render a controlled radio group from SelectOption items. Options: :name, :label (group aria-label), :vertical?, :disabled, :on-change (receives the picked value and d!), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-radio-group |calcit
  [] (respo-ui.schema/SelectOption :value |calcit :label |Calcit) (respo-ui.schema/SelectOption :value |clojure :label |Clojure)
  Option :some $ respo-ui.schema/RadioGroupOptions :name (Option :some |language) :label (Option :some |Language)
```

### `comp-field (label control options)`

Wrap a form control with a label, optional description, and error message. Options: :for (id of the labelled control), :description, :error (rendered with role=alert), :required?, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-field |Email
  comp-input | $ Option :some
    respo-ui.schema/InputOptions :placeholder $ Option :some |you@example.com
  Option :some $ respo-ui.schema/FieldOptions :description (Option :some "|Used for notifications.") :required? (Option :some true)
```

## Navigation

### `comp-tabs (options tabs on-route)`

Render horizontal or vertical tabs from TabRoute items. TabsOptions sets :selected, :vertical?, :width, and styles; on-route receives the clicked TabRoute.

```cirru
comp-tabs
  respo-ui.schema/TabsOptions :selected $ Option :some :book
  [] (respo-ui.schema/TabRoute :tab :book |Book) (respo-ui.schema/TabRoute :tab :card |Card)
  fn (route d!)
    hint-fn $ {} (:return 'Unit)
      :args $ [] (:: 'respo-ui.schema/TabRoute 'Tag)
        :: 'Fn $ {}
          :args $ [] 'Dynamic
          :return 'Unit
    match route $
      :tab value _title
      d! $ :: :select-tab value
```

### `comp-breadcrumb (items options)`

Render a breadcrumb trail. Items with :href render links; the last item is marked aria-current=page. Options: :separator (default /), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-breadcrumb
  []
    respo-ui.schema/BreadcrumbItem :label |Home :href $ Option :some |#/
    respo-ui.schema/BreadcrumbItem :label |Components
  Option :none
```

### `comp-pagination (page total options)`

Render page buttons for a 1-based page out of total pages, collapsing distant pages into gaps. Options: :siblings (pages beside the current one, default 1), :on-change (receives the next page and d!), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-pagination 5 20 $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/PaginationOptions :siblings $ Option :some 1
```

### `comp-steps (current items options)`

Render a step indicator. current is the 0-based active step; earlier steps show as done. Items carry :title and optional :description. Options: :vertical?, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-steps 1
  [] (respo-ui.schema/StepItem :title |Account) (respo-ui.schema/StepItem :title |Profile) (respo-ui.schema/StepItem :title |Done)
  Option :none
```

## Disclosure and hints

### `comp-collapse (title content options)`

Render a native details/summary disclosure. Content may be text or a Respo node. Options: :open? (initial state), :name (details sharing a name open one at a time), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-collapse "|What is Respo?" "|A virtual DOM library in Calcit." $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/CollapseOptions :open? $ Option :some true
```

### `comp-tooltip (content tip options)`

Show a CSS-only tooltip when the content is hovered or focused. Options: :placement (:top by default, or :bottom), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-tooltip |Save "|Saves the draft" $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/TooltipOptions :placement $ Option :some :bottom
```

### `comp-kbd (key-names options)`

Render a keyboard shortcut from key names, joined with +. Options: :class-name and :style.

```cirru
comp-kbd ([] |Ctrl |K) (Option :none)
```

## Feedback

### `comp-alert (kind content options)`

Render an accessible alert. Kinds are :info, :success, :warning, and :error; content may be text or a Respo node.

```cirru
comp-alert :success "|Changes saved"
```

### `comp-progress (value options)`

Render an accessible progress bar. Value is clamped visually to 0..100; options support :class-name and :style.

```cirru
comp-progress 72
```

### `comp-spinner (options)`

Render an accessible loading spinner. Options support :label, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-spinner $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/SpinnerOptions :label $ Option :some "|Loading results"
```

### `comp-skeleton (options)`

Render an animated loading placeholder. Unlabeled skeletons are decorative; pass :label to expose role=status. Options: :kind (:text or :circle), :width, :height, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-skeleton $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/SkeletonOptions :label (Option :some "|Loading title") :width $ Option :some |60%
```

### `comp-empty (title options)`

Render a richer empty state with optional :icon, :description, :action, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-empty "|No results" $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/EmptyOptions :description $ Option :some "|Try another search term."
```

### `comp-badge (content options)`

Render a small count or status badge. Options: :kind (:info, :success, :warning, :error), :dot? (render a dot and expose content as aria-label), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-badge |12 $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/BadgeOptions :kind $ Option :some :error
```

## Data display

### `comp-card (content options)`

Render a composable card. Content may be text or a Respo node; options support :title, :footer, :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-card |Content $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/CardOptions :title $ Option :some |Summary
```

### `comp-avatar (text options)`

Render initials or an image avatar. Options: :src, :alt, :title, :size (:small or :large), :class-name, and :style.

```cirru
comp-avatar |CY $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/AvatarOptions :title (Option :some "|Chen Yong") :size $ Option :some :large
```

### `comp-tag (kind content options)`

Render a small semantic tag. Kinds are :info, :success, :warning, and :error; any other tag uses the neutral style. ButtonOptions :on-click, :class-name, and :style apply.

```cirru
comp-tag :success |Stable $ Option :none
```

### `comp-attributes (options)`

Render a responsive label/value grid from AttributesOptions :items. Each item may carry :label, :value (text or a Respo node), and :span; options also set the title, item size, and CSS overrides.

```cirru
comp-attributes $ respo-ui.schema/AttributesOptions :title (Option :some |Project) :items
  [] (:: :attr |Name |Respo) (:: :attr-span |Description "|A virtual DOM library in Calcit" 2)
```

### `comp-divider (options)`

Render a horizontal divider, or a vertical divider with :vertical? true.

```cirru
comp-divider $ Option :some
  respo-ui.schema/DividerOptions :vertical? $ Option :some true
```

### `comp-time (time)`

Render a time string, parsed with dayjs. Today's times show only the clock time; other days show the date and weekday.

```cirru
comp-time |2026-10-20T08:00:00Z
```

## Code and utilities

### `comp-snippet (code options)`

Render plain preformatted code. Options: :class-name and :style.

```cirru
comp-snippet "|yarn install" $ Option :none
```

### `comp-cirru-snippet (text options)`

Render Cirru code with syntax highlighting. Options: :class-name and :style.

```cirru
comp-cirru-snippet "|defn f (x) x" $ Option :none
```

### `comp-copy (code f)`

Render a copy icon. Clicking copies code to the clipboard, unless a handler is passed, which then replaces the default copy.

```cirru
comp-copy "|caps --ci" $ Option :none
```

### `comp-close (options)`

Render a clickable close (✕) mark. ButtonOptions :on-click handles the click; :class-name and :style adjust presentation.

```cirru
comp-close $ Option :none
```

### `comp-placeholder (text)`

Render a muted placeholder text block for empty areas.

```cirru
comp-placeholder "|Nothing here yet"
```

### `comp-catoptric-text (text options)`

by "catoptric text" I mean text added with CSS content, thus unsearchable from browser search or select. The text can still be grabbed from DOM tree though.

```cirru
comp-catoptric-text |Respo $ Option :none
```
